posts.t:
Eeeeeesh. Joseph Woll just gave up a horrendous goal to Tristan Luneau. 4-3.

I guess that evens out the Foerster goal, but yikes. Flyers trailing for the first time today.

Tyson Foerster with a shorthanded goal! If there's a guy on this team who desperately needed a good-luck tally, it's Foerster. Puck just kinda squeezed through Dostal -- definitely one he should have stopped. 3-2.
Flyers to an early power play. Tyson Foerster got clipped with a high-stick after moving well through the neutral zone. Pretty back and forth in the early stages of this one.

Tyson Foerster has just 5 goals and 1 assist for 6 points in his last 28 combined regular season and playoff games. There's been no bigger disappointment on the roster so far this season. Maybe the little one-game break helps him. We'll see.

threads.t: Tyson Foerster scores a Short handed goal from the corner.
